summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 (Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup) — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the write-journal/replay code covering 7 scope items across 6 plans with no behavior changes.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (research, validation, pattern mapping, 6 plans in 5 waves, verification passed). Execution reached Wave 3 of 5 with plans 45-01, 45-02, and 45-03 committed; 45-04 was spawned but the transcript ends before its result returns.

repo: Phase 45 lives on branch `feat/desktop-fuse-write-durability-cleanup`; all plan commits target that branch.
The FUSE crate is `cipherbox-fuse` (feature flag: `fuse`); the API surface extractor does not cover Rust and returns 0 symbols — skip that gate for Rust-only phases.
Vendored `fuser` ABI file (`fuse_abi.rs`) carries pre-existing dead-code warnings unrelated to any phase work — treat as noise.
`fuse/windows/mod.rs` is `cfg`-excluded on macOS, which causes rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' warnings that are not errors.
The desktop app (`apps/desktop/src-tauri`) is a downstream consumer of `cipherbox-sdk`'s `JournalOp` type; type changes in the SDK must be verified workspace-wide, not just in `cipherbox-fuse`.
The git commit helper emits a false-negative `commit_failed` result when lint-staged runs successfully; always confirm with `git log` rather than trusting the helper's exit signal.
`auto_advance: true` is set in `.planning/config.json` and would chain plan→execute automatically; the orchestrator paused and asked before honoring it.

code.finding: IDE showed E0308 (expected Option<String>, found String) after plan 45-03 — confirmed stale rust-analyzer cache; `cargo check --workspace` exited 0 with no errors.
IDE showed String-vs-Option comparison error after 45-03 — also stale cache; not a real compile error.

workflow: rust-analyzer diagnostics can reflect mid-edit state from a subagent executor and appear as errors even after clean commits; always gate on `cargo check --workspace` exit code, not IDE output.

When every serial wave touches the same file (lib.rs here), worktrees add merge/manifest risk with no parallelism benefit — running sequentially on the feature branch is the correct call even when worktrees are technically enabled.
The correct post-merge verification command for this workspace is `cargo check --workspace && cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse -p cipherbox-sdk` — 43 + 48 tests, exit 0 is the green bar.
Plan 45-01 (characterization test suite) must land first in Wave 1 to serve as the behavior-preservation oracle for all subsequent refactor waves; this ordering is load-bearing.

friction: Git commit helper returned false-negative `commit_failed` on a successful commit (lint-staged stdout was mistaken for failure); required a follow-up `git log` to confirm the commit landed.

rust-analyzer showed stale compile errors (E0308 in read_ops.rs:821, Display-on-Option in macros.rs, String-vs-Option in mod.rs:59) after the 45-03 executor committed — triggered an unnecessary workspace re-verification round.
The API surface extractor returned 0 symbols for the Rust codebase; the gate ran but produced nothing useful, adding latency with no signal.
VALIDATION.md was created from a template with unfilled placeholders and required a follow-up edit after the verification pass flagged them as a warning.
